correctness.units: predictions are LOGW = ln(WEIGHT_G in grams); grams = exp(q0.5)

hypotheses: Unknown COMPOUND_ID embedding plus the control flag failed to apply a RAT offset in globally normalized LOGW, so outputs sat near dog-typical inverse scale (~9.1).
Extra-split vs official robustness difference is unexplained: official pooled used the same global normalizer and nan token but did not collapse to MAE 0.55.
not_confirmed: Checkpoint selection (last vs best) as the cause: extra-split val_loss was healthy.
SPECIES encoder mis-mapping: locked encoder classes were DOG=1, RAT=2.
